title: Confirm I-Keeping Books product truth
question: Your plan is the brief. Confirm these product decisions so I can write PRODUCT.md and start the build.

options.label: Build the plan as written
options.thesis: Android Flutter app with offline SQLite CRUD, Provider, bottom nav (Home / Books / Categories / More), glass digital-library UI, and the five book categories from the plan.
options.viewport: Phone-first Android: Dashboard first, then Books with FAB, Categories, Settings.
options.risk: Locks stack and feature scope to the attached plan; later changes need a deliberate update.

options.label: Flutter for Android and iOS
options.thesis: Same plan features and glass library UI, but ship as adaptive Flutter for both Android and iOS from day one.
options.viewport: Phone-first on both OSes; Material navigation with platform back/safe-area guarantees.
options.risk: Slightly broader platform work; Android remains the primary verification target.

options.label: Essential CRUD only
options.thesis: Ship Add / View / Edit / Delete / Search / Categories with SQLite first; defer dashboard stats, low-stock, dark mode, and About polish.
options.viewport: Books list as the primary screen with FAB and search.
options.risk: Faster to a working core, but the digital-library dashboard feel arrives later.
